summary.title: status should not load better-sqlite3
summary.what: better-sqlite3 is now lazy-required on the first openReadDb/openWriteDb. Sidecar JSON read lives in index-sidecar.ts; SQLite snapshot/persist/fallback moved to index-sidecar-sqlite.ts. CLI no longer statically imports the query/indexer/db barrel. An empty leftover WAL is treated as missing so sidecar identity stays valid. Sidecar-hit status and --version do not dlopen the native addon.
summary.why: Bet 3 moved coverage proof off the body SQLite file (int_46dedca7), but the process still imported better-sqlite3 at startup because connection.ts and shared.ts had value imports and status pulled the db barrel through the sidecar module. That native load was the remaining tax above the Node/commander floor. A 0-byte WAL leftover also invalidated sidecar identity on the live Codex index, forcing status back into SQLite and hiding the Bet 3/4 win.

decisions.point: How to keep the native addon off the startup path
decisions.chose: createRequire(import.meta.url)('better-sqlite3') inside openReadDb/openWriteDb, plus import type in shared.ts. Split sidecar JSON from SQLite persist/fallback.
decisions.rationale: esbuild bundles the CLI into one file without --splitting, so a local dynamic import is inlined. Only a runtime require of the external native module keeps dlopen off --version and sidecar-hit status.
rejected: esbuild --splitting and a multi-file publish layout
A default daemon/watcher to amortize process start

decisions.point: What counts as a matching WAL identity
decisions.chose: Treat a missing WAL and a 0-byte WAL as the same (walMtimeMs=0, walSize=0). Non-empty WAL still compares mtime and size.
decisions.rationale: Identity answers whether uncheckpointed body writes exist. An empty WAL leftover after checkpoint or a reader touch is not a body change. On the live 393MB Codex index this was the only reason status still opened SQLite.
rejected: Comparing WAL mtime even when size is 0

decisions.chose: Dynamic import inside sync/find/read/list/stats actions. Status stays on collectStatus + sidecar read. Error classes used for instanceof live in db/errors and query/session-not-found.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the source graph sqlite-free for status/--version under tsx/vitest. In the published single-file bundle the JS is still parsed, but the native addon is not loaded.
rejected: A second published bin just for --version/status

rejected.alternative: A default daemon that keeps SQLite warm
rejected.reason: Product boundary: Sherlog stays a one-shot CLI with manual incremental sync. Daemon is never the default.

rejected.alternative: Truncating content_text or adding another freshness cache
rejected.reason: Out of scope for the process-floor bet; retrieval truth stays in the body index.

review_notes: npm run check: tsc --noEmit && vitest 254/254. PR #104 CI test job passed.
dist/cli.js has no static from "better-sqlite3" import; the only call is require('better-sqlite3') inside loadSqlite().
Live Codex: DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES shows no better_sqlite3.node on --version or sidecar-hit status --selector after the empty-WAL identity fix. Session count 6196 still comes from the sidecar.
No JSON contract change. Global shlog remains 0.4.2 until the 0.4.3 registry release.

architectural_claims: The better-sqlite3 native addon loads only when a Sherlog process actually opens a SQLite connection.
Sidecar-hit status and --version stay on the metadata plane and do not dlopen better-sqlite3.
A missing WAL and a 0-byte WAL are the same identity: no uncheckpointed body writes.
There is no default daemon or watcher.
behavioral_changes: Sidecar-hit status no longer loads better-sqlite3 in the published CLI.
An empty leftover WAL no longer forces status to open SQLite.

data_model_changes.name: index.meta.json dbIdentity WAL fields
data_model_changes.migration_notes: Readers now treat empty WAL as missing. Existing sidecars with walMtimeMs=0/walSize=0 start matching again when only an empty WAL leftover exists.

migration_notes: No database schema change. Already-written sidecars keep working. After upgrade, status hits the sidecar even if a 0-byte WAL file is present.
